Those to score "firsts" for us were Wiley (100 yards and Long Jump), Bird (880 yards), Grassau (Shot). Second points were scored on our behalf by Abberton (Mile), Quackenbos (High Jump), Murdoch (880 yards), Sutton (Shot), and single points for third places came from Johns (220 yards and 100 yards),…

Pack, Michael, Herbert and Bird will value their bronze medals. Our team ran impressively in their heat, and in the final Eddie Pack gave our team a splendid start, unofficial watches timing him to do a shade outside 50 seconds.
Bird was third in the 880 yards, and T.
Perhaps the performance which gave us most pleasure was that of our team (Bird, Botwright, Jarlett, Pack) in taking second place to Achilles A.C. in the A.A.A. 4 x 440 yards Relay Championship.
Our Relay team (Bird, Blunden, Pritchard, Pack) win in fine style; and our lads in the Three Miles race (Smart, Cohen, Carter) gave us another team win.

It was one of Pack’s best runs to date and if he could only find something of a finish, I would back him against the best in the country. In the 880 yards Alby Bird ran his usual consistent race and although coming up against his “bogey” man, A.
